text:
alex: Ran into a weird one after the ts-sdk@1.2.0 deploy — rerank requests are 400/422 and the scores array in the request arriving at our infra is null or [object Object].

maya: ugh, can you paste the exact payload you sent? sample code?

alex: minimal repro (ts sdk):
```ts
const scores = new Float32Array([0.23, 0.78]);
await client.rerank({
  input: { query: 'find best', candidates: ['a','b'], scores },
});
```
server logs show body: `{"input":{"query":"find best","candidates":["a","b"],"scores":{"0":0.23,"1":0.78}}}`

samir: ah that looks like Float32Array serialized to an object. JSON.stringify on typed arrays becomes keyed object in V8. SDK should convert to plain array before sending.

julie: what error is the API returning? 400 or 422? any message from validation?

alex: sometimes 400 bad request with "scores must be array of numbers"; other times 422 with "unexpected score format". Also one user reported mismatched candidate order after parse.

maya: can you repro with fetch/raw POST? try converting scores to Array(...) as a workaround.

alex: workaround fixed it: `scores: Array.from(scores)` and request goes through and server returns expected rerank order. But several customers using typed arrays in edge workers hit this.

samir: filing SDK bug — likely in request serializer. Also we should add validation in the platform to reject keyed-object score maps with clear error, instead of treating numeric keys unpredictably.

julie: any telemetry that shows how many failed requests from ts-sdk 1.2.0?

alex: deploy-bot, can you pull recent 24h 4xxs for /v1/rerank with user-agent containing "redwood-ts-sdk/1.2.0"?

deploy-bot: query queued. returning ~72 4xx errors in last 24h; top error message: "scores must be list of numbers"; top regions: us-west-2.

maya: ok prioritize: 1) quick patch to TS SDK to coerce typed arrays to plain arrays before JSON serialization; 2) server-side soft-fix to accept keyed numeric maps by converting to array when keys are 0..n-1 (but log a distinct metric); 3) add clear validation error message for customers.

samir: also add unit test that serializes Float32Array and sends to http mock — ensure produced payload is array. Draft PR in ts-sdk repo.

alex: adding a tiny repro snippet for support ticket so they can workaround: `const safeScores = Array.isArray(scores) ? scores : Array.from(scores);`

julie: customer message templates? keep short: "We're aware of a bug in ts-sdk@1.2.0 where typed arrays may be serialized incorrectly; please upgrade to patched SDK or convert scores to regular arrays as a temporary fix. We're rolling a server-side tolerance fix now."

maya: one more gotcha: some users were sending header `Content-Type: text/plain` from edge worker bundlers; that caused bodyParsing to pick text mode and then our JSON reparsing incorrectly. ensure client sets `application/json`.

samir: good catch — SDK should explicitly set content-type and stringify the body after coercion. I'll include that in the PR.

alex: customer escalations: two customers hit billing spikes because retries happened when client got 4xx and retried 3x. ops, can we credit them?

julie: raise for billing review — tag billing-team. Recommend temporary credit and note patch ETA.

maya: I'll add a short changelog entry and a safety doc in support KB with repro and workaround.

alex: thx all — PR incoming: ts-sdk#402. Follow-up after deploy.

samir: follow-up note: also check Python SDK surface for users passing numpy arrays; we should mirror the fix there (np.array -> list).
